scope: Finite mathematical/computation specification, not a numeric executable certificate or an accepted full cost/correctness assembly. Pure bodies and compiled functional theorem TYPES only; no proof values, runtime source counter, supplied answer or analysis callback replay.
procedure_identifier_convention: R[Module.declaration] is an exact module/original-declaration identifier resolved by SOURCE-INDEX and original context metadata; it is not a claim that every module name is a Lean namespace. RMAF.agreement, RMAF.partitionCheck, RMAF.pairwiseEmbeddings and ForestState.targetAgrees have the actual canonical namespace bindings in AGREEMENT-DATA.

meterFirstChoice/meterRule4Select exact data/control/guard cases and full Choice/Priority/LocalGuard types
exact6 properness/Contains/Erase/Perm/Leaves/Nodup bodies, including four actual Leaves occurrences and eager Perm

compiled_functional_support.use_condition: After the explicit projected-runtime/canonical-value binding, apply these exact compiled functional contracts at their actual input/predicate hypotheses. They do not establish operation cost or source-counter occurrence coupling.
compiled_functional_support.QueryExact_definition: none: for every F, agreement T S F=true implies q<F.length-1. some F: agreement T S F=true, F.length-1<=q, and for every G with agreement T S G=true, F.length<=G.length.

runtime_bindings.query_root: Projection of ordinaryCompleteStepSource with every value-recursive FastOrdinary.solve occurrence bound to QUERY, never to a host/source oracle
runtime_bindings.paid: cutoff FastOrdinary.solve parentBudget / actualCallback(parentBudget) becomes PAID(parentBudget), with a real r<parentBudget test
runtime_bindings.common: same-budget QUERY only after actual strict leaf-count comparison
runtime_bindings.forest: actual GenericForest.solve becomes FOREST with its exact fixed PAID closure; recursive overlap calls require1<=d<=q
runtime_bindings.optimizer: sourceOptimizeMeter value spine with actual QUERY, finite leaf fuel and no w/C argument; exactly one retained actual RECOVER after selectedSome
runtime_bindings.plain_primitives: Use TREE-DATA and AGREEMENT-DATA literal plain bodies at plain source positions; do not substitute eager metered bodies merely because their returned values agree
runtime_bindings.properness: Use the exact PROPERNESS-DATA body at every OrdinaryProper occurrence, including repeated pretest and Rule4 priority calls
runtime_bindings.other_callbacks: Only the finite lexical predicates/adapters explicitly written in the body appendix; no callback is an additional public input

input_and_fees.domain: canonical Tree=leaf Nat|node Tree Tree, rooted binary without an added root; packed U(T,S) and q words, empty heap and zero other registers; paid elementary decoder in representation specification
input_and_fees.k: optimum common-forest COMPONENTS; q=k-1; optimizer does not receive k
input_and_fees.implementation: same natural-word/log-cost elementary operations,32 registers,immutable fresh heap; new finite mathematical control/activation implementation,without any claim to be the optional old numeric candidate

limits: Finite body/index supply is an author specification, not a semantic closure certificate or independent acceptance. The remaining actual proof/size/cost/assembly obligations are stated in REMAINING-v1.md. Earlier numeric candidates and their holes are unchanged.
